summary: First test iteration for Aura MVP. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (init, day CRUD, AI content + caching, calendar, search across pages 5/6/10, insights, isSpecial logic for day1/day2/day7, user isolation). Frontend: full 12-step Expo/RN flow (mobile 390x844) executed end-to-end including Taking Control -> Weekly Goals -> Blessings -> Affirmations (card selection) -> Workout (Cardio chip) -> Daily Goals -> Quote -> Yesterday actions -> Tomorrow (Yes + All + notes + actions) -> Journal -> Weekly Reflection -> Final affirmation. After Finish, home shows 'Continue today's check-in'; Calendar highlights Sep 6 as Journaled with 1 Entry / 1 Days logged / 1 streak; Search finds journal marker and 'cardio' (correct pages 10 & 5); Progress screen shows 1 longest streak, 1 day journey, workout breakdown Cardio=1; tapping Sep 6 on Calendar deep-links to /day/2026-09-06 and displays the saved entry; re-opening flow rehydrates saved values (persistence OK). No red screens, no console errors, no deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). All AI content generation via emergentintegrations/gpt-5.4-mini works and is cached per (userId,date). No React Native issues detected.

issues: Bottom tab items lack testID/tabBarTestID; testing had to fall back to text selectors. Add testID to each NativeTabs.Trigger for robustness.
Day cells in the calendar grid have no testID; tests relied on text '6'. Consider testID like `calendar-day-2026-09-06` for reliability.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add testID/tabBarTestID to bottom tabs and testIDs to calendar day cells so future UI tests avoid text-based selectors.

(Nice-to-have) Consider fixing pytest-xdist loadscope splitting for shared-state suites — currently tests are grouped in one class to stay on one worker; ideally use a filesystem-shared user_id fixture or run these tests with `-n 0`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ[...] for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME (fails fast) and excludes _id via projections — good.
AI content is cached in daily_content per (userId,date); repeat GET returns identical affirmations/quote — verified.
isSpecial rule (day==1 or day%7==0) matches spec for weekly pages 1/2/11.
Search covers exactly the searchable pages (1,3,5,6,8,9,10) per spec.
flow.tsx is 532 lines — under 700-line threshold but could be modularized per step for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Test users are anonymous and generated per pytest session (prefix TEST_) and per browser context. No prod data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_aura_api.py and is xdist-safe (all data-dependent tests are consolidated into TestAuraFullFlow so loadscope pins them to one worker). Frontend testIDs are comprehensive for the flow but the tab bar and calendar day cells rely on text selectors. Anonymous userId is stored in IndexedDB via AsyncStorage web shim — each fresh browser context creates a new user, so any persistence test must run inside a single browser context.
